claim: CRISPR-Cas9 acts as RNA-guided molecular scissors to induce double-strand DNA breaks.
evidence: The Cas9 endonuclease utilizes a synthetic guide RNA sequence to introduce precise double-stranded breaks at targeted genomic loci.
label: supported

claim: Penicillin is effective against acute viral influenza infections.
evidence: Penicillin is a beta-lactam antibacterial compound that inhibits bacterial peptidoglycan cell wall synthesis and has no activity against influenza viruses.
label: unsupported

claim: Dark matter comprises exactly 84.7% of all baryonic matter in the observable universe.
evidence: Current cosmological estimates indicate non-baryonic dark matter constitutes roughly 85% of total cosmic matter, though total matter differs fundamentally from baryonic matter.
label: ambiguous
